description: This file implements a cache mechanism for Google Cloud Storage (GCS), supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations for storing and retrieving cached responses via HTTP requests. It defines a GCSCache class that manages interactions with GCS buckets, including setting, getting, and batch operations.
